chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr al-Zayyāt, from a man from our companions, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام descended to Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله and said to him: “O Muḥammad, indeed Allah gives you glad tidings of a child who will be born from Fāṭimah, whom your community will kill after you.” So he said: “O Jibrāʾīl, and upon my Lord be peace; I have no need for a child who will be born from Fāṭimah and whom my community will kill after me.” Then he ascended, then descended عليه السلام, and said to him the like of that. So he said: “O Jibrāʾīl, and upon my Lord be peace; I have no need for a child whom my community will kill after me.”

Then Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام ascended to the heaven, then descended and said: “O Muḥammad, indeed your Lord conveys peace to you and gives you glad tidings that He will place in his offspring the Imamate, the Wilayah, and the successorship.” So he said: “I am pleased.” Then he sent to Fāṭimah that Allah gives me glad tidings of a child to be born to you, whom my community will kill after me. So she sent back to him: “I have no need for a child from me whom your community will kill after you.” Then he sent to her that Allah has placed in his offspring the Imamate, the Wilayah, and the successorship. So she sent back to him: “I am pleased.”

So his mother bore him with hardship, and brought him forth with hardship, and his bearing and his weaning were thirty months. Until, when he reached his full strength and reached forty years, he said: “My Lord, inspire me to give thanks for Your blessing which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and that I may do righteousness that pleases You, and set right for me in my offspring.”

And had he not said, “Set right for me in my offspring,” all of his offspring would have been Imams. Al-Ḥusayn did not suckle from Fāṭimah عليها السلام, nor from any woman. He would be brought to the Prophet, and he would place his thumb in his mouth, and he would suck from it what sufficed him for two or three days. Thus the flesh of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام grew from the flesh of the Messenger of Allah and his blood. And none was born at six months except ʿĪsā ibn Maryam عليه السلام and al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام.

And in another narration from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام: al-Ḥusayn would be brought to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, and he would place his tongue in his mouth, and he would suck from it and suffice himself by it; and he did not suckle from any woman.

key_terms.الْإِمَامَةَ: the divinely appointed Imamate placed in his progeny
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةَ: divinely granted authority and guardianship in his descendants
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلَ: Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام, the angel who conveyed the divine message
key_terms.مَوْلُودٍ: a newborn child being given as glad tidings

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the foretelling of Imam al-Ḥusayn’s birth, martyrdom, and the Imamate in his progeny?
ai.summary: This narration describes how Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام brought the glad tidings of the birth of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, together with the foretelling of his martyrdom, until the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and Fāṭimah عليها السلام accepted it because Allah had placed the Imamate, Wilayah, and successorship in his progeny. It also connects the event to a Qur'anic passage and mentions the special nourishment and early birth of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Amro Al Zayyat, from a man from our comanions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> descended unto Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and said to him<sup>saww</sup>: ‘O Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Give you<sup>saww</sup> glad tidings that (Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup> will be Blessed with the one<sup>asws</sup> who Your<sup>saww</sup> community will kill after you<sup>saww</sup>’. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘O Jibraeel<sup>saww</sup>, and upon my<sup>saww</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> be the greetings! Why there is a need for me<sup>saww</sup> regarding a son<sup>asws</sup> whom my<sup>saww</sup> community would be killing after me<sup>saww</sup>’. 
So he<sup>as</sup> ascended, then descended, and said to him<sup>saww</sup> the likes of that. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘O Jibraeel<sup>as</sup>! And upon my<sup>saww</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> be the greetings! Why there is a need for me<sup>saww</sup> regarding a birth whom my<sup>saww</sup> community would be killing, from after me<sup>saww</sup>’.

So Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> ascended to the sky, then descended, so he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>! Your<sup>saww</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> Conveys the greetings and Gives you<sup>saww</sup> that He<sup>azwj</sup> would be Making to be Imams<sup>asws</sup> in his<sup>asws</sup> offspring, and the Wilayah, and the successorship’. So he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> have been pleased’. 
Then he<sup>saww</sup> sent a message to (Syeda) Fatima<sup>asws</sup>: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Gives you<sup>asws</sup> glad tidings that you<sup>asws</sup> will be Blessed (with a son). My<sup>saww</sup> community would be killing him<sup>asws</sup> after me<sup>saww</sup>’. So she<sup>asws</sup> sent a message to him<sup>saww</sup>: ‘Why there is a need for me<sup>asws</sup> having the one<sup>asws</sup> who would be killed by your<sup>saww</sup> community after you<sup>saww</sup>’. So he<sup>saww</sup> sent a message to her<sup>asws</sup>: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Made to be in his<sup>asws</sup> offspring, the Imamate, and the Wilayah, and the succesorship’. So she<sup>asws</sup> sent a message to him<sup>saww</sup>: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> have been pleased’.

[46:15] with abhorrence did his mother bear him and with abhorrence did she bring him forth; and the bearing of him and the weaning of him was thirty months. When heasws reached strength and reached forty years of age, heasws said: ‘Lordazwj! Advise measws to thank for Yourazwj Bounties which Youazwj have Favoured upon measws and upon myasws parents, and the righteous deeds Youazwj would be Pleased with, and Correct for measws among myasws offspring’.

And had he<sup>asws</sup> not said ‘Correct for me<sup>asws</sup> among my<sup>asws</sup> offspring’, it would have been so that his<sup>asws</sup> offspring, all of them would have been Imams<sup>asws</sup>. 
And Al-Husayn<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> did not take milk from Fatima<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, nor from a (another) woman. He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> used to be brought to the Prophet<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>, so he<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> would place his<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> thumb in his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> mouth, so he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> would suckle from it what sufficed him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> for two days or three. Thus, the flesh of Al-Husayn<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> was built from the flesh of Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> and his<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> blood. And there was not come in (in the world) a six months except for Isa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> Bin Maryam<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> and Al-Husayn<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>’.

And in another report from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, they used to come to him<sup>saww</sup> with Al Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>saww</sup> would morsel for him<sup>asws</sup> his<sup>saww</sup> own tongue, so he<sup>asws</sup> would suckle with it, and he<sup>asws</sup> did not breastfeed from a woman’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from ‘Abd al-Rahman al-‘Arzami from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“The time between the birth of al-Hassan and the conception for al-Husayn was like one menstuaral cycle and the time between the birth of the two was six months and tendays.”
